title: GitBracket spec
description: Tournament schedule specification consumed by `node gb.js schedule specs/<slug>.json`. Each spec generates one tournament file under site/tournaments/<slug>.json.

slug.description: URL-safe tournament identifier, used as the filename and in route fragments.

name.description: Human-readable tournament name, shown on the list and tournament pages.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for all scheduled times, e.g. Europe/Zurich.

date.description: Event date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be a real calendar date (no 2026-02-30). Cross-midnight sessions use the start date.

poolSize.description: Maximum teams per round-robin pool. Pools are filled evenly so sizes differ by at most one.

blocks.description: Start time per category in HH:MM (24h), mapped by category id. Each category's matches begin at this time and advance in slotMinutes steps.

venues.description: Available courts/venues, mapped by venue id. The order determines court-assignment priority (first venue gets the first available slot).

players.description: Registered players, mapped by player id. Incomplete registrations stay out until the pair is complete.

categories.description: Competition categories (e.g. Men's Doubles, Mixed). Each category can have its own bestOf, slot length, final overrides, knockout toggle, and placement depth.

id.description: Category identifier, referenced by blocks and teams.

name.description: Human-readable category name shown on standings and schedule pages.

bestOf.description: Games per match. Applied to both groups and knockout stages (overridable via final.bestOf). Must be odd.

slotMinutes.description: Match slot length in minutes. Applied to both groups and knockout (overridable via final.slotMinutes).

final.description: Overrides for the final and bronze matches (bestOf and/or slotMinutes). Without it they use the stage defaults.

bestOf.description: Games for the final and 3rd-place match. Must be odd.

slotMinutes.description: Slot length for the final and 3rd-place match, minutes.

knockout.description: Whether to build a single-elimination knockout after the group phase. Default true for multi-pool categories, false for single-pool. Set true to enable knockout from a single pool (everyone advances); set false to suppress knockout even with multiple pools.

placements.description: Highest rank to determine via placement matches. Power of 2 >= 2: 2 = final only (no bronze), 4 = 3rd/4th play-off (default), 8 = adds 5th-8th classification, 16 = adds 9th-16th, etc. Only matters when knockout is active.

teams.description: Team registrations per category. Each team is an array of player ids (1 for singles, 2 for doubles). Shuffle before the final run for a fair pool draw.
